title: Consent-safe content decisions without behavioral cold-state creation
scope: Strict owned content decision consent on both hosts before profile computation or measurement. False-only stored/cookie/strict GET query hints persist before acknowledgement, true cannot enable. No cold behavioral creation; only necessary refusal storage. One owned session read or existing signed serialized DO content projection. Neutralize affinity/stage/visit under either refused switch and request region/channel under tracking refusal; preserve consenting holdout context and permitted tracking-only measurement. Keep deterministic candidate/ranking core unchanged. Unsigned internal both-false monitor calls are explicitly synthetic/state-free; reject other unsigned service calls.
non_goals: Not full W05/F05/F10/N06/N11/N12 closure: other ingress/capture/telemetry/logging/general snapshots, SDK collection, global absent-state and necessary-record lifecycle policy, transactional concurrent withdrawal, prior contributions and human D03/D06/customer approval remain open. Existing absent-state default remains; malformed stored state/DO envelopes are not consent.

No scorer/holdout-science/merchandising/registry/surface/config mismatch redesign, new store/binding/RPC/header protocol, SDK/build/native/new harness/framework/whole-tree retest, deployment/cloud/credentials/customer-data/staging/commit/push/destructive/unrelated changes. Monitor caller stays unchanged; synthetic service probe is not whole-path shopper/runtime/SLO acceptance. Root alone owns governance.

criteria.description: Actual signed content decision route on both hosts uses all four stored switches without cookies; either refusal returns default ranking with empty affinity inputs/no private scoring drivers and neutral affinity/stage/visit cells in top-level and every record. Tracking=false additionally yields unknown channel/null region and no ring/exposure/analytics/queue writes after background drain; tracking=true/personalization=false preserves request context and permitted neutral default measurement but no learned exposures. Warm consenting controls truly rank against nonempty candidates and exercise configured destinations; consenting randomized default holdout context stays intact.

Strict owned session read and single signed serialized DO content projection honor false-only cookie and optional strict boolean GET trackingConsent/personalizationEnabled hints (mapped to service consent); persist necessary refusal before acknowledgement and retain it on later hint-free requests, never upgrade through true hints; explicit preferences may enable. Cold anonymous decision makes no behavioral/profile/visit/user-pointer writes, necessary refusal only; malformed/read/required-write/ownership/forward/recognized and malformed/missing/failed DO envelopes deny without receipt or fanout. Gate private computation under refusal, not merely score weight. Only explicit both-false unsigned synthetic calls remain state-free; other unsigned service calls reject. Correct receipt reason; skip unused default lift reads.

Independent actual before/final source, fixture assertions, baseline and full worker evidence review with fixed K1 rerun; app noEmit/scoped diff pass inspected, artifact pins and relevant graph checked. Lead accepts bounded local content containment only, preserving exact historical overlap, all failed/reworked evidence and residual/next-action handoff.
